title: Search and filters: show the right requests while preserving the rest
goal: Find your own request number, apply a numeric filter and restore the full list while explaining visibility changes.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 2; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: Yesterday the list had four requests; today one is visible. Before creating duplicates, read its filter. Field, comparison and value jointly determine visibility. In 30/45/30/15 find the single 45; the independent 20/55/40/45 set yields three rows at a different threshold.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Work in the installed training service. Nexus stores the lesson and your note, but does not change the external infobase. Give report control its own separate practice with the four specified requests; 0/1440 probes and earlier 20/55 must not silently enter its total. Preserve earlier infobases. The ready-made report requires no BSL.

sections.title: Search asks where your record is
paragraphs: A number taken from your saved form identifies your particular request. The Поиск (Ctrl+F) box searches the displayed set under platform rules. It neither creates records nor changes customer links. Check the search text and active restrictions before assuming a request is missing.

Search may operate within an already restricted period or filtered set. An empty result is not evidence of deleted data. Clear the search, disable your filter and check the period, then compare the infobase and actual number.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Request-1/2/3 are table labels, not numbers to enter into your infobase.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: A filter has a field, comparison and value
paragraphs: ДлительностьМинут — Больше или равно — 45 compares each numeric duration with 45. For 30, 45 and 30 only the 45-minute request is visible. The equality part includes the boundary; Больше would give an empty result on that dataset.

The condition checkbox controls whether it applies. Its text and value may remain visible while unchecked: the setting is retained but no longer restricts rows. This allows reversible comparison without deleting either records or the setting.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: A ≥45 filter shows one request. Did the other three disappear from the infobase?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. The selection changes. In the 30, 45, 30, 15 control set only 45 matches. Remove that condition and find all four previous numbers without recreating documents.

sections.title: Read combined restrictions carefully
paragraphs: Search text, a period and a duration filter can apply together. Searching the number of a 30-minute request while ≥45 is active gives an empty set. Understand the intersection instead of creating the request again. Change one restriction at a time and record what restores the row.

Advanced И and ИЛИ groups mean all conditions and at least one condition respectively. Start with one numeric condition. For an additional experiment predict the matching numbers manually before combining conditions. A list setting changes neither document validation rules nor access permissions.

sections.title: Context and transitions
paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: An empty set under incompatible restrictions does not prove data loss; reversibly disable your condition first.
Disable restrictions one at a time and compare restored numbers.

sections.title: Check reversibility and identity
paragraphs: Record your numbers and durations before filtering. Compare matching numbers with that table, then disable the condition and verify all original numbers return. A row count alone is weaker because different requests can share a duration.

Keep additional training records rather than deleting them to match a picture. Include them in your baseline and calculate the expected set using the same rule. Screenshots contain original synthetic verification data; your names, dates and numbers may differ.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: For the independent set use a separate own practice with the service CF and no earlier requests: East has 20, 55, 40 minutes; West 45. Record the four actual numbers. Set DurationMinutes ≥40. List the expected numbers and minutes before applying it, compare the result, then remove the condition. Preserve the 30/45/30/15 worked set and earlier work; if there are more records, first separate your new infobase.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

paragraphs: The author uses three new separate training infobases:control 4/120, a new 4/160 set and input validation. The actual report DCS and ordering/filter queries run; records are compared after restarting. Three GUI captures show only their labelled states. Complete manual form entry, every list setting, installer, permissions and learner actions are NOT RUN.

steps.title: Separate new set
steps.action: Prepare a separate service infobase and four requests:East 20/55/40, West 45. Note your numbers; preserve previous infobases.

steps.title: Three filter parts
steps.action: Select DurationMinutes, Greater than or equal, 40. Before applying note expected 55/40/45.

steps.title: Compare numbers
steps.action: Compare the three exact numbers as well as the count. Check for an additional customer filter.
steps.expected: The condition explains every visible record.

steps.title: Remove only the filter
steps.action: Disable the condition and find all four old numbers, including 20. Delete or recreate nothing.
